notes: Fonts are Figma stand-ins (Roboto): font families and text widths are not compared; text rows drift by the label width.
Icon strokes: Figma resizes icon instances at a fixed 1.5 px stroke; the canonical SVGs are 20-unit artwork with stroke-width 1.5, so the browser draws 1.2 px at 16 px and 1.8 px at 24 px.
Each button frame sets an explicit mode of Oddkin · Content colour (Text, On action, Selection) so its icon takes the label colour; the exporter records bindings, not modes.
The spinner turns in code (paused at its first frame for captures); Figma draws a static arc.
